description.zh:
指定购买的优化求解器License类别信息，包含一种类别：

- `MP`：数学规划
description.en:
The category of the purchased Optimization Solver License. The following category is supported:

- `MP`: mathematical programming.

description.zh:
指定购买的求解器版本信息，目前仅支持一种：

- `1`：本地运行版
description.en:
The version of the purchased solver. Only the following value is supported:

- `1`: local runtime edition.

description.zh:
* `1`：前后一天
* `2`：前后一周
* `3`：前后一月
description.en:
* `1`: one day before and after
* `2`: one week before and after
* `3`: one month before and after.
